options.name: onRead
options.doc: Invoked for each row captured during the initial snapshot of a table, before streaming of live changes from the replication slot begins.

params.name: afterEntry
params.doc: The row as captured. Declare a record type to project its columns, see the rowState data-binding rule.

params.name: tableName
params.doc: Name of the table the row came from, useful when one service handles several tables. Omit the parameter entirely if it is not needed.

options.name: onCreate
options.doc: Invoked when a row is inserted.

params.name: afterEntry
params.doc: The row's state after the insert. Declare a record type to project its columns, see the rowState data-binding rule.

params.name: tableName
params.doc: Name of the table the change occurred in, useful when one service handles several tables. Omit the parameter entirely if it is not needed.

options.name: onUpdate
options.doc: Invoked when a row is updated, with both the pre- and post-change images of the row. Unless the table's REPLICA IDENTITY is set to FULL, the pre-image carries only the columns that make up the replica identity (the primary key by default), with the rest unset.

params.name: beforeEntry
params.doc: The row's state before the update.

params.name: afterEntry
params.doc: The row's state after the update.

params.name: tableName
params.doc: Name of the table the change occurred in, useful when one service handles several tables. Omit the parameter entirely if it is not needed.

options.name: onDelete
options.doc: Invoked when a row is deleted. Only the pre-change image is available, and unless the table's REPLICA IDENTITY is set to FULL, it carries only the columns that make up the replica identity (the primary key by default).

params.name: beforeEntry
params.doc: The row's state immediately before it was deleted.

params.name: tableName
params.doc: Name of the table the change occurred in, useful when one service handles several tables. Omit the parameter entirely if it is not needed.

options.name: onTruncate
options.doc: Invoked when a table is truncated. No row images are available, only which table was affected.

params.name: tableName
params.doc: Name of the table that was truncated, useful when one service handles several tables. Omit the parameter entirely if it is not needed.

options.name: onError
options.doc: Invoked when the connector fails to capture or dispatch a change event.

params.name: cdcError
params.doc: The failure that interrupted change capture.

rules.message: A CDC service must declare at least one change handler. onError alone never receives a change event, so the service would do nothing.
